fact: By September 2025 over 25 million residents had been registered for Fayda, which is mandatory for new bank accounts, TINs, property and notary transactions, SIM registration and exam enrollment, and integration is progressing with CRVS, the Ministry of Revenues, the Ministry of Agriculture and RRS/UNHCR.
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Ethiopia Digital ID for Inclusion and Services Project (P179040)
